scenario_description: Serena was planning a surprise for her husband's birthday. She wanted to throw him a party, but his schedule was tough. He would always arrive home at widely different times. To get around it, she worked with his co-workers. Together they were able to surprise him perfectly.
dialogue_tree: <Start, State1, Introduction, Neutral, "Serena: Hey, did you get the decorations for the party?">
<State1, State2, Planning, Neutral, "Co-worker: Yes, everything is set up according to the plan.">
<State2, End, Success, Happy, "Husband: Wow, this is amazing! Thank you, everyone!">
